news.summary: U.S. stock-index futures declined on Sunday, as investors ponder the likelihood of a fresh interest-rate hike and as new fighting between the U.S. and Iran threatens to reignite the conflict.

news.title: Party balloons could become a ‘luxury’ as the Iran war spurs a helium shortage
news.summary: Dollar Tree says a helium squeeze has hit sales of balloons and party supplies. Researchers note this could foreshadow higher costs for other industries that depend on the gas.

news.title: What new tariff walls in U.S.-Canada trade war mean for the economy's critical metals
news.summary: When the U.S.-Canada trade war erupted, the market repriced metals and materials stocks and ETFs, but longer-term investors should be wary.

news.title: Gold Is on Shining Again. Is It Too Late to Get In?
news.summary: Everyday investors shouldn’t be timing gold—or any market. Rather, it’s best to pick an asset allocation you’re comfortable with and hold it long-term. In the Permanent Portfolio, fund manager Michael Cuggino maintains a fixed target percentage of various assets regardless of what the market is doing.

news.title: Trump-promoted Freedom Fuel stations sold gas a distributor says went unpaid for
